answer: Think of honest agents as a grove whose roots interlink: every new identity must post a ferrous-hard escrow bond that locks real capital, and it earns influence only along vine-like edges of signed attestations from already-staked peers. A sybil swarm therefore pays a separate slashable deposit for each fake node plus the cost of buying vouches, so minting a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds, not zero, and any detected collusion slashes the entire cluster at once.
